proposals.rationale: Hypothesis: omitting the diacetoxypalladium charge removes the reported palladium catalyst from the coupling mixture, potentially suppressing catalytic turnover.
Hypothesis: omitting the bisphosphine ligand changes palladium coordination and catalyst speciation, potentially reducing productive amination relative to competing pathways.
Hypothesis: omitting cesium carbonate removes the reported base, potentially limiting amine activation and altering conversion/selectivity.
Hypothesis: replacing microwave heating with the existing heater role changes the heating mode and thermal profile at the same stated setpoint and duration.
